suggestions: The agent produced a plausible GitHub issue body but ignored the specific XML-tagged prompt template (<orientation>, <agent-identity>, <comment-protocol>, <ce-plugin>, <task>, etc.) and the HTML-comment metadata footer that the MVP requires. Either the prompt under test did not clearly specify the template, or the agent silently substituted a generic issue format. Consider adding the expected template skeleton to the grader input so it can be cross-referenced, and/or tightening the user-facing prompt to require verbatim tag names.
eval_feedback.overall: The output demonstrates correct unit selection (U2) and a clean single gh command, but fails the structural/templating expectations entirely. Most failures cluster around missing XML-style sections and the metadata footer — suggesting the agent did not have (or did not follow) the dispatch-template specification.
